title: Sintel: Watch and Answer
description: A fantasy short film about a young woman searching for a dragon. Watch it, answer, and discuss the ending. Contains some fantasy violence. Open movie by the Blender Foundation (CC BY).

questions.prompt: Watch the film. What is Sintel looking for?
questions.explanation: She tells the old man she is searching for a dragon.

questions.prompt: How did Sintel meet the baby dragon?

options.text: She found it hurt and took care of it.
She bought it at a market.
It was a gift from her father.

questions.explanation: She found the little dragon injured and helped it.

questions.prompt: What name did she give the dragon?
questions.explanation: She called the baby dragon Scales.

questions.prompt: What happened to the baby dragon?

options.text: An adult dragon carried it away.

questions.explanation: A big dragon took it away, so she went to find it.

questions.prompt: What is the surprising truth at the end?

options.text: The big dragon she fought was Scales, grown up.
Scales was never a real dragon.
The old man was the dragon.

questions.explanation: Many years had passed, and Scales had grown up.

questions.prompt: How would you describe the ending?
questions.explanation: It's a sad ending. Discuss: what would you have done?
